sources: Ukraine Prosecutor General's Office via Ukrinform; President Zelenskiy on X via Al Jazeera; Kharkiv Mayor Ihor Terekhov on Telegram; Yaroslavl Governor Mikhail Yevrayev via Al Jazeera; US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff on X
fault_line: Hospital strike as war crime vs collateral damage in an energy-war barrage -- and whether Moscow timed the barrage for the US vote or Kyiv is framing a winter campaign.

sections.what_happened: Kharkiv's Nemyshlianskyi-district city clinical hospital was hit at ~03:20 on Nov 3; 73 people were injured (patients, medical staff, nearby residents), up from the early 25-wounded figure carried in earlier Nov 3 scan records (Ukrinform notes 62 as the intermediate figure). Zelenskiy on X: 'the Russians directly struck a city clinical hospital. Seventy-three people were injured, and the cardiology department, where people were receiving treatment, was damaged.' Terekhov: 1,000+ windows shattered. Prosecutor's preliminary finding: fragments suggest a FAB-250 aerial bomb with UMPK-5R guidance module; a war-crime investigation (Criminal Code Art. 438(1)) is open. Evacuation figure VARIES by outlet: ~200 patients (Synegubov, earlier record) vs 226 (Hromadske/Euromaidan via NewsCord comparison) -- do not merge. Dnipro: a hospital damaged, 1 killed and 15-17 injured (outlet counts vary), plus a hospice for elderly/terminally ill patients damaged (Mayor Filatov). Yaroslavl refinery drone fire injured 2 employees (Gov. Yevrayev). Air Force via NV: 309 aerial targets shot down/suppressed (49 of 59 cruise missiles, 257 drones). Kyiv Post reports Zelenskiy warned in his Tuesday evening address that Russia is preparing another large-scale attack on energy and logistics -- timing of that address vs the Nov 2 preparation warnings is not cleanly separable in the piece, so it is carried as attributed, not as a confirmed new warning.
sections.what_verified: 4 declared families: Al Jazeera, Ukrinform, NV, Reuters (barrage numbers/photo). Kyiv Post and United24 Media are NOT in the source registry and are reported with attribution only, never counted.
sections.what_disputed: Russia's Defence Ministry says it targeted electricity facilities in Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions supplying the army and military factories (same AJ piece); no Russian statement on the hospital itself appears in these pieces. Earlier same-day figures (25 wounded, 200 evacuated) are superseded on toll but the evacuation variance is unresolved.
sections.why_matters: CORRECTION, not a new Short: any barrage Short must carry 73 (not 25) for Kharkiv hospital, the cardiology-department detail, and the 1,000+ shattered windows; do not use the 200/226 evacuation figure until one count is confirmed. Proven-set (NATO/Russia) but a revision, not a new event.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP + IN-WINDOW CORRECTION TO 1100-02/1500-01/1900-04 (Ukrinform published 2026-11-03T09:29+02 = 11:29 , absent from all earlier Nov 3 records which carried the early 25-wounded figure; surfaced in-window via AJ/NV/Kyiv Post search at ~19:58 ) -- Kharkiv hospital toll revised to 73 injured; preliminary FAB-250/UMPK-5R finding; Dnipro hospital/hospice casualties; Zelenskiy evening warning of another large-scale attack

totw_analysis: Our read: CORRECTION, not a new Short: any barrage Short must carry 73 (not 25) for Kharkiv hospital, the cardiology-department detail, and the 1,000+ shattered windows; do not use the 200/226 evacuation figure until one count is confirmed. Proven-set (NATO/Russia) but a revision, not a new event. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Hospital strike as war crime vs collateral damage in an energy-war barrage -- and whether Moscow timed the barrage for the US vote or Kyiv is framing a winter campaign.
